inputs.text: [warmly] [slowly] Hi, Mum... It's me. [short pause] How are you feeling today?
[softly] [slowly] Oh... I'm all right. [short pause] A little tired, that's all. [short pause] [warmly] How are you?
[conversational] I'm okay. Busy at work. [short pause] Did you manage to call the doctor?
[gentle] Yes, yesterday. [short pause] They're going to call me back with an appointment.
[reassuring] Let me know when you hear. [short pause] I'll see if I can come with you.
[gentle] Listen, I'd better get back to work. [short pause] Can I call you this evening?
[warmly] All right. Speak tonight. Love you.
